---
title: "Computing environment"
---

The Python environment is fully specified by `pyproject.toml` and locked by
`uv.lock`; the R packages by `R/install-packages.R`.  The versions actually
used to render this copy of the book are:

```{python}
#| label: appA-env
#| code-summary: "Record the environment of this render"
import json, platform, shutil, subprocess
from mdmx import provenance
env = provenance.environment()
print(json.dumps(env, indent=1))
for tool in ("quarto", "Rscript", "latexmk"):
    path = shutil.which(tool)
    if path:
        out = subprocess.run([path, "--version"], capture_output=True, text=True)
        print(f"{tool}: {(out.stdout or out.stderr).splitlines()[0] if (out.stdout or out.stderr) else '?'}")
    else:
        print(f"{tool}: not found")
```
